title: Name the failing test in the integration queue's check-failed detail
body: When a queue check fails, the integration detail keeps only the last OUTPUT_TAIL_LINES of stdout+stderr (run_child/tail_lines in src/integrate.rs). For cargo test that tail is mostly compiler warnings on stderr, so it never names the failing test (seen on card kg5ktv: the suite had to be rerun to find it). Keep the tail, but also pull out the lines that name the failure (e.g. 'test ... FAILED', 'panicked at', 'error:') and put them first, with a bound on length. Keep it independent of any one tool, and don't parse cargo's output format. Update docs/integration-queue.md.
